wikipediaSummary.title: Out of Our Heads
wikipediaSummary.description: 1965 studio album by the Rolling Stones
wikipediaSummary.extract: Out of Our Heads is the third studio album by the English rock band the Rolling Stones, released in two editions with different covers and track listings. In the United States, London Records released it in July 1965 as the band's fourth American album, while Decca Records released its UK edition on 24 September 1965 as the third British album.
